# Meemaw - French Dictation & Spelling App (iOS)

Meemaw is a premier iOS educational application designed to make learning French spelling, grammar, and conjugation fun, positive, and stress-free for children (CP to Brevet des Collèges), students, and adult learners (FLE & Voltaire Certification).

## Core Philosophy
- Positive reinforcement instead of red-ink school punishment.
- Vibrant Neo-Brutalist & Pop-Art comic aesthetic.
- 100% on-device local neural French voice synthesis (no privacy invasion, works offline).
- Apple Family Sharing: 1 single purchase or subscription for the whole household.

## Educational Levels (CP to Brevet & Adultes)
- Primaire (CP, CE1, CE2, CM1, CM2): fundamental sounds, silent letters, plural agreements, basic conjugations.
- Collège (6ème, 5ème, 4ème, 3ème): past participle rules, grammatical homophones (ses/ces, c'est/s'est), official Brevet dictation preparation.
- Adultes & FLE (Français Langue Étrangère): professional correspondence without errors, Certificat Voltaire training.

## Key Features & Game Modes
- Voice Dictations (Dictée Longue & Dictée Express) with customizable speech speed and pauses.
- Kids vs Parents Duels (Duels Enfants vs Parents): challenge parents or friends via SMS/WhatsApp with instant score comparison.
- Gamification & Meemaw Coins 🪙: earn gold coins on perfect 20/20 scores, climb Game Center global leaderboards.
- Detective Mode (Détective): find traps and errors hidden in passages.
- Anagrams, Crosswords, and QCM grammar quizzes.
- Meemaw's Rules & Tips (L'Astuce de Meemaw): concise, memorable grammatical explanations.

## Availability & Downloads
- Platform: iOS (iPhone & iPad)
- App Store URL: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757681331
- Official Website: https://meemaw.app/
- In-App Events: "Défi Dictée : Rentrée 20/20" (Fall 2026 Challenge)
